@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+name: ci-lint-hook
+on: [push]
+jobs:
+  test:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.12'
+      - run: pip install pytest
+      - run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_r27_lint_hook.py

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def lint_score(text: str) -> int:
+    return len(text.split())

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from internal.r27_lint_hook import lint_score
+
+
+def test_lint_score():
+    assert lint_score('one two three') == 3
